description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'WebConfig' that implements 'WebMvcConfigurer' to set global CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) policies, allowing a frontend (React app) to access backend APIs by configuring allowed origins, methods, headers, credentials, and cache duration.

classes.name: WebConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that sets up CORS mappings for the backend API.

methods.name: addCorsMappings
methods.description: Overrides the method to configure CORS settings, allowing specific origins, methods, headers, credentials, and cache duration.
